ctx.x: And the rest is Thomas, Big Wash. Now you got Joe James on piano. And Wash is on saxophone. And Manuel Paul, he's on sax. And Sam Pins is on the drums. And Thomas is on trumpet.
And then the bass player and the other trumpet player. Mm-hmm.
